# atlassian_jira_workflow_scheme_attachment (Resource)

Attach a workflow scheme to a Jira project. Only applies when the project has no issues (classic projects). Team-managed projects may not support this.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (numeric or key).
- `workflow_scheme_id` (String) Workflow scheme ID to assign to the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: project_id/workflow_scheme_id.
